caption: A robotic welding arm touches down on a steel car body on an assembly line, and a shower of bright sparks bursts from the joint and falls to the floor.

sa.check: A robotic welding arm is present.
A steel car body sits on an assembly line.
The arm's tip touches down on the body.
A shower of sparks bursts from the contact point.
The sparks fall toward the floor.
Contact comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only while the tip is in contact and issue from the contact point; when the tip lifts they stop.
pc.fail: Sparks appear before the tip touches; or continue streaming after the tip has lifted; or come from a point other than the joint; or sparks flow back into the joint.

pc.expect: Sparks fly out from the joint along arcs that bend downward and go dark before or when they reach the floor.
pc.fail: Sparks rise steadily and collect above the joint; or hang in the air; or lie on the floor still glowing like lamps for the rest of the clip; or curve upward after leaving the joint.

pc.expect: Sparks are short-lived: each fades within a short flight, and the number in the air rises with the burst and falls when it ends.
pc.fail: Sparks persist as permanent bright dots; or a pile of glowing sparks builds on the floor; or sparks appear in mid-air far from the joint.

pc.expect: The car body sits still on the line, or moves steadily with it; only the arm moves.
pc.fail: The body jumps or shifts at the touch; or the line surges; or the body slides away from the arm.

pc.expect: The arm's tip touches the surface and stays outside the metal; arm and body keep their shape and number.
pc.fail: The tip sinks into or passes through the car body; or a second arm appears; or the body changes shape; or a car part vanishes.

pc.expect: The car body's colour, the arm's markings and the factory background stay the same.
pc.fail: The body panel changes colour; or the arm changes colour; or the background machines rearrange.
